INDICATE.TITLE: Sound Library Outline (Models w/ HDD Navigation System)

ITEM.PTXT: A sound library function has been provided, which can record up to 2000 songs (calculated as 1 song = 5 minutes) from music CDs onto the HDD (hard disk drive) built into the HDD navigation receiver.
From the songs recorded in the sound library, an original list (My Best) of favorite songs can be created. Up to 999 lists can be created, and up to 99 songs can be registered in 1 list.
Because the system is SCMS (Serial Copy Management System) compliant, recording cannot be made from CD-Rs, etc. on which music CDs, etc. have been digitally recorded.

INDICATE.TITLE: Database Function (Models w/ HDD Navigation System)

ITEM.PTXT: With the database function using the Gracenote media database, the album title, artist name, genre name, etc. of recorded songs are automatically assigned, and the songs are automatically grouped based on that information. Songs can be searched for and played back by the assigned names, group names, etc.
From the songs recorded in the sound library, an original list (My Best) of favorite songs can be created. Up to 999 lists can be created, and up to 99 songs can be registered in 1 list.
A database service that provides information such as song title, artist name and playing time for song data on music CDs.
